title: Grand Theft Auto hype reaches London's Selfridges department store, as a GTA 6-themed takeover appears in real life, featuring a varsity jacket that costs an eye-watering £2,500
summary: Selfridges is selling loads of GTA 6-related merchandise. Some of it is staggeringly expensive, but some of it isn't, and it's all quite nice.

Image credit: Rockstar / Selfridges News by Robert Purchese Associate Editor Published on Nov. 9, 2026, 12:18 p.m. 4 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google Expensive British department store Selfridges has launched a sizeable Grand Theft Auto 6 takeover, completely making-over its Oxford Street London Corner Shop store and offering a considerable line of clothing, which includes an exclusive varsity jacket that costs a bank-melting £2,500. Note, you can buy the GTA 6 items online as well. Live from Selfridges at Oxford Street for the #GTAVI activation🌴 Rockstar are not messing around 🤯 pic.twitter.com/vqqXKwB1oJ - GTA GFX (@GTAGFX) November 9, 2026 To see this content please enable targeting cookies. Manage cookie settings That GTA 6 varsity jacket is by far and away the most expensive item (and it's apparently already sold out), next to a non-exclusive varsity jacket that's £1,750, whereas the other items are pricey but conceivably affordable. There are a few ranges on offer. There's a nice bright teal and pink-coloured range based around the spoof NFL team the Vice City Manatees, which includes a manatee plushie, an American football, a jacket, and other bits and bobs. There's also a range based around the spoof NBA team, the Vice City Narcos, that includes a basketball (there's a standard GTA 6-branded basketball too). 1 of 5 Caption Attribution There's a range based on the spoof fast-food chain Burger Shot, which includes a visor, work uniform, and apron, amusingly. There are some admirably horrid postcard-decorated shirts and shorts, and there's a lot of generic game-branded caps and T-shirts besides, all in quite nice colours. Quirky branded offerings include an ashtray, money clip and dartboard. It's all quite attractive stuff. There's no word on how long the items will be stocked for or that the Selfridges Corner Shop takeover will run for, other than "while stocks last". Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives 19th November - next week - so the hype machine is now in full effect. GTA 6 pre-load dates, times and details have been announced, and we know what the GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements will be.
